name: com.snap.creativekit.internal.SnapCreativeShareResultHandler
description: When an app sends content to Snapchat through Snap CreativeKit (Snap Inc.), the SDK includes this receiver as the target for a follow-up broadcast. In this version, the receiver does not process the result.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app will not receive that follow-up share-result broadcast; the share screen itself is started through a separate Snapchat handoff.
